question: Which goddesses, pleased by the good-strength ritual, always protect us and are venerable to vīra lords?
inference: Proper performance of the good-strength ritual secures protection from the pleased goddesses.
uncertainties: Segmentation of subhabalividhinā into subha, bali, and vidhi is interpretive.
vīrendravandyāḥ may describe the goddesses or the ritual context.
plain_english: May the pleased goddesses, always venerable to vīra lords, protect us by the good-strength ritual.
